architecture_review_board: SYF Enterprise Architecture & Cyber Security Governance (CISO / CTO)

pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.title: Tier-1 Cardholder Data (CHD) & CareCredit HIPAA PHI Zero-Egress Mandate
pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.rule: Zero external cloud egress for Tier-1 Cardholder Data (16-digit PAN, SSN) and CareCredit Healthcare PHI (MRN, ICD-10). No GenAI prompts, completions, or OpenTelemetry spans may egress to external multi-tenant or hybrid SaaS telemetry endpoints outside Synchrony's private AWS ROSA OpenShift VPC.
pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.enforcement: Inline deterministic regex scrubbing ([REDACTED_PAN], [REDACTED_SSN], [REDACTED_MRN], [REDACTED_ICD10]) via json.dumps()/json.loads() (zero eval()) inside the FastAPI OTel Collector Proxy (<15ms inline DLP budget) before persistence to self-hosted ClickHouse v24.3 + PostgreSQL 16 inside AWS ROSA (us-east-1).

identity_and_authentication.title: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OIDC & Mutual TLS 1.3 Standard
identity_and_authentication.rule: All internal API and telemetry proxy endpoints must authenticate client SDKs using Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OIDC JWT bearer tokens (300s local asynchronous JWKS public keyset cache at 1.8ms verification overhead) alongside strict mTLS 1.3 transport encryption.

inline_dlp_and_telemetry_ingestion_laten.domain: Inline DLP & Telemetry Ingestion Latency SLA (<25ms)
inline_dlp_and_telemetry_ingestion_laten.title: Inline DLP & Telemetry Ingestion Latency SLA (<25ms P95) & Red Hat UBI9 Non-Root Standard
inline_dlp_and_telemetry_ingestion_laten.rule: End-to-end evaluation proxy and telemetry ingestion overhead inside Synchrony's AWS ROSA OpenShift VPC (us-east-1) must remain strictly under <25ms P95 (engineered at 13.8ms P95: 1.8ms cached Entra ID JWKS auth + 4.2ms inline regex DLP scrubbing + 7.8ms async OTel protobuf ring-buffer batching on Red Hat UBI9 Python 3.12 non-root UID 1001).

baseline_api_gateway_ingress.title: Baseline v1.0 API Gateway Ingress Topology
baseline_api_gateway_ingress.rule: In Baseline v1.0, North-South API traffic routes through Synchrony's existing Kong Enterprise API Gateway v3.4 with TLS 1.3 termination and per-tenant rate limiting.
